title: Frank Driggs's letters about Southwest jazz
summary: Interviewer relays Driggs's letter about a musician in Houston; Albert says he helps Driggs where he can.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Well, this is Anderson Lacy's letter wrote to Driggs and told him that he was living in Houston. He's age 72 or 73. And Driggs wrote to you on February 9, 1971. So I don't know if he's living in the other one.
Well, I don't think he is. Frank Briggs wanted a lot of international Southwest jazz musicians. And our friends to him as much as I possibly can. Now, let's see.
